CameraPresetSelector.cameraNotInPresetsEnterSensor: Camera not in presets: enter sensor/focal specs to compute the footprint
CameraPresetSelector.noCameraSetTheLineSpacing: No camera: set the line spacing directly (e.g. rover/lawnmower deck width)

EnginePlanLegend.theAreaIsFlownOneNumbered: - the area is flown one numbered zone at a time. A color just means a different zone.
EnginePlanLegend.tealTheRouteTheEngineCalculated: (teal) - the route the engine calculated, with real turns.
EnginePlanLegend.blueTheWaypointsThatGoTo: (blue) - the waypoints that go to the drone. It skips the turn loops: a copter just turns in place at each line end.
EnginePlanLegend.turnLoopsMayExtendOutsideThe: Turn loops may extend outside the boundary - the vehicle needs turning room. To keep turns inside a legal area, mark a workspace polygon in the Area Editor.

FleetSurveyPanel.drawASurveyPolygonFirstThen: Draw a survey polygon first, then split it across vehicles.
FleetSurveyPanel.bandsAreNonOverlappingMissionsUpload: Bands are non-overlapping; missions upload sequentially to each vehicle on any connected link. Timing deconfliction is out of scope here.

SurveyConfigPanel.followACenterlineRoadsRailPower: Follow a centerline (roads, rail, power lines, pipelines)
SurveyConfigPanel.fixedWingStripsGetOvershootAnd: Fixed wing: strips get overshoot and racetrack turns at sharp bends
SurveyConfigPanel.multirotorTurnsOnTheSpotNo: Multirotor: turns on the spot, no overshoot or turn loops
SurveyConfigPanel.driveForwardThenReverseNoU: Drive forward then reverse: no U-turns (Ackermann/car-like rovers, needs ArduRover DO_SET_REVERSE support)
SurveyConfigPanel.altitudeAboveTerrainAglAtEach: Altitude above terrain (AGL) at each point
SurveyConfigPanel.noPolygonInThatFileSo: No polygon in that file, so the line was loaded as a corridor centreline.
SurveyConfigPanel.clickTheSurveyButtonOnThe: Click the Survey button on the map toolbar, then draw a polygon to plan a grid.
SurveyConfigPanel.importABoundaryFromAKml: Import a boundary from a KML, KMZ, GeoJSON, or Shapefile (.shp / zipped)
SurveyConfigPanel.saveCurrentSettingsAsAPreset: Save current settings as a preset
SurveyConfigPanel.splitThisSurveyAcrossTheConnected: Split this survey across the connected fleet
SurveyConfigPanel.lineBasedCaptureAlongASubject: Line-based capture along a subject. To plan an area survey instead, exit and pick another survey type from the Survey menu.
SurveyConfigPanel.aPointToSelectItIts: a point to select it - its
SurveyConfigPanel.appearDragTheSquareArmHandles: appear. Drag the square arm handles to shape the curve through that point (right-click an arm to reset it). Drag the point itself to move it, right-click to delete, click a faint dot or the dashed line to add a point.
SurveyConfigPanel.panoramaNeedsARealCameraThe: Panorama needs a real camera: the frame size at range drives the plan. Pick a camera preset instead of Manual corridor.
SurveyConfigPanel.startAtPerimeterEndAtCenter: Start at perimeter, end at center
SurveyConfigPanel.startAtCenterEndAtPerimeter: Start at center, end at perimeter
SurveyConfigPanel.perpendicularPassFliesForBetterPhotogram: Perpendicular pass flies {{v1}} (+{{crossGridAltitudeOffset}}%) for better photogrammetry.
SurveyConfigPanel.bothPassesAtTheSameAltitude: Both passes at the same altitude. Raise to fly the second pass higher.
SurveyConfigPanel.mTurnRadiusLooksTooTight: m turn radius looks too tight for a fixed wing at
SurveyConfigPanel.mSALevel30Bank: m/s: a level 30° bank turn needs about
SurveyConfigPanel.mTheEngineWillPlanTurns: m. The engine will plan turns the aircraft can't track.
SurveyConfigPanel.smoothedWaypointsOnACopterAdd: Smoothed waypoints on a copter add many extra waypoints for turn curves it doesn't need; Corners is usually the better choice.
SurveyConfigPanel.saveTheseSpecsAsANamed: Save these specs as a named camera in the dropdown
SurveyConfigPanel.setsLineSpacingDirectlyForGround: Sets line spacing directly. For ground vehicles (rover/lawnmower) where the corridor is the operating width, not a camera footprint.
SurveyConfigPanel.setTargetGroundSampleDistanceAltitude: Set target ground sample distance; altitude is derived
SurveyConfigPanel.sampleGroundElevationAtEveryWaypoint: - sample ground elevation at every waypoint and hold
SurveyConfigPanel.aboveItBakesAbsoluteMslAltitudes: above it (bakes absolute MSL altitudes, no onboard terrain data needed).
SurveyConfigPanel.usableFlightTimePerBatteryAfter: Usable flight time per battery (after your reserve). Drives the battery estimate.
SurveyConfigPanel.theLineYouDrawIsWhat: The line you draw is what gets captured. The flight path is computed beside it, the highlighted band shows what fits in frame, and the camera turns to face the line at every waypoint.
SurveyConfigPanel.aircraftFliesOnTheSideOf: Aircraft flies on the {{side}} side of the line (in drawing direction); camera faces the other way
SurveyConfigPanel.distanceFromTheSubjectToThe: Distance from the subject to the flight path. Together with altitude it sets the camera range, so it drives frame size and photo spacing.
SurveyConfigPanel.theMissionPansTheCameraSmoothly: The mission pans the camera smoothly: each leg carries a yaw command whose turn rate spreads the rotation across the whole leg.
SurveyConfigPanel.copterSetWpYawBehaviorTo: Copter: set WP_YAW_BEHAVIOR to 0 so mission yaw commands hold; otherwise the aircraft snaps toward each next waypoint instead.
SurveyConfigPanel.clickTheMapDoubleClickTo: Click the map, double-click to finish
SurveyConfigPanel.drawABranchCenterlineThatForks: Draw a branch centerline that forks off this corridor
SurveyConfigPanel.fliesThisFarPastEachStrip: Flies this far past each strip end before turning, so the turn happens off the mapped line. Junctions are left alone. It also sets the size of the turn waypoints below.
SurveyConfigPanel.aStraightRunOntoTheFirst: A straight run onto the first line, so the aircraft is lined up before it starts rather than still turning across the first photos.
SurveyConfigPanel.bendsSharperThanThisGetRacetrack: Bends sharper than this get racetrack turn waypoints so the plane re-enters the next leg aligned.
SurveyConfigPanel.noBendOnThisCentrelineIs: No bend on this centreline is that sharp, so none are added.
SurveyConfigPanel.cornerWithTwoTurnsOfAbout: ° corner with two turns of about
SurveyConfigPanel.whichIsTheTighterManoeuvreRaise: °, which is the tighter manoeuvre. Raise it if the plane is overshooting the line.
SurveyConfigPanel.skipLinesSoEach180Turn: Skip lines so each 180° turn has room: 1, 3, 5 then 2, 4
SurveyConfigPanel.flyThem123In: Fly them 1, 2, 3 in order, whether or not the turn fits
SurveyConfigPanel.thePlaneWillRollOutWide: The plane will roll out wide and miss the start of each line.
SurveyConfigPanel.flyTheStripsStartingFromThe: Fly the strips starting from the far side
SurveyConfigPanel.reverseTheTravelDirectionAlongThe: Reverse the travel direction along the centerline
SurveyConfigPanel.drawTheCenterlineAsAPath: Draw the centerline as a path (roads, rail, power lines). Strips run parallel to it; an odd strip count rides the centerline, even straddles it.
SurveyConfigPanel.missionInsertsDoSetReverseBetween: Mission inserts DO_SET_REVERSE between lines. Rover firmware must support it.
SurveyConfigPanel.standardZigzagPatternRoverTurns180: Standard zigzag pattern. Rover turns 180° at each line end.
SurveyConfigPanel.buffersTheBoundaryBeforeItIs: Buffers the boundary before it is sent to the engine: positive grows coverage past the edge, negative keeps lines inside.
SurveyConfigPanel.picksEachRegionSLineDirection: picks each region's line direction and turn style itself, so the Angle, Overshoot and Turns controls don't apply. Use the engine parameters above (turn radius, waypoints, track width) to steer the plan.
SurveyConfigPanel.buffersTheBoundaryPositiveGrowsCoverage: Buffers the boundary: positive grows coverage past the edge, negative keeps lines inside.
SurveyConfigPanel.fixedWingExtendTheShorterLine: Fixed-wing: extend the shorter line end at each turn for a clean 180° racetrack turn
SurveyConfigPanel.multirotorTurnOnTheSpotLines: Multirotor: turn on the spot, lines connect directly
SurveyConfigPanel.enterEveryLineFromItsOther: Enter every line from its other end
SurveyConfigPanel.flyTheLinesInTheOpposite: Fly the lines in the opposite order, starting from the far side
SurveyConfigPanel.movesTheStartCornerWithThe: Moves the start corner. With the grid angle, these two reach all four corners, so the first line is the one nearest your launch point.
SurveyConfigPanel.cameraTriggersOnlyAlongTheScan: Camera triggers only along the scan lines; off during the turn-arounds outside the boundary
SurveyConfigPanel.thisSurveyWasBuiltFromRev: ; this survey was built from rev
SurveyConfigPanel.editingPolygonDragPointsOnThe: Editing polygon - drag points on the map (zoom in to reach them).
SurveyConfigPanel.finishEditingAndRecomputeTheWaypoints: Finish editing and recompute the waypoints
SurveyConfigPanel.shapeIsLockedUnlockToMove: Shape is locked - unlock to move vertices
SurveyConfigPanel.editTheBoundaryDragVerticesOn: Edit the boundary - drag vertices on the map, then Done recomputes the waypoints
SurveyConfigPanel.unlockTheShapeSoItCan: Unlock the shape so it can be dragged again
SurveyConfigPanel.lockTheShapeSoTuningThe: Lock the shape so tuning the settings cannot move it
SurveyConfigPanel.saveThisAreaShapeAndSettings: Save this area (shape and settings, no waypoints) so it can be reused in another mission or on another machine
SurveyConfigPanel.oneAircraftEachFlightIsA: One aircraft: each flight is a continuous stretch of the route, all lines included, so you finish a section then move along
SurveyConfigPanel.swarmEachFlightTakesSomeOf: Swarm: each flight takes some of the parallel lines over the whole route, so several aircraft work side by side
SurveyConfigPanel.splitIntoOneBatterySizedFlight: Split into one battery-sized flight group per sortie; upload each from the table
SurveyConfigPanel.pickAPresetOrStayWith: Pick a preset (or stay with current settings)

SurveyMapOverlay.dragToShapeTheCurveRight: Drag to shape the curve · right-click to reset
SurveyMapOverlay.clickToAddAControlPoint: Click to add a control point

SurveyStartButton.drawAPolygonFillItWith: Draw a polygon, fill it with a lawnmower grid
SurveyStartButton.drawACenterlineRoadsRailPower: Draw a centerline (roads, rail, power lines), strips run parallel
SurveyStartButton.drawTheSubjectShorelineCliffFrontage: Draw the SUBJECT (shoreline, cliff, frontage); flight path, camera yaw and triggers are computed for you
SurveyStartButton.planASurveyAreaPolygonGrid: Plan a survey: area (polygon grid) or corridor (centerline strips)
SurveyStartButton.fullWindowEditorMultiAreaHoles: Full-window editor: multi-area, holes, KML import

index.boustrophedonLawnmowerPatternParallelSca: Boustrophedon lawnmower pattern. Parallel scan lines across the polygon with overshoot for turns.
index.twoPerpendicularGridPassesHigherPhoto: Two perpendicular grid passes. Higher photo density and improved 3D reconstruction over a single grid.
index.orbitAPointOfInterestAt: Orbit a point of interest at fixed radius.
index.inwardOrOutwardSpiralWithinThe: Inward or outward spiral within the polygon.
index.linearSurveyAlongACenterlineRoads: Linear survey along a centerline (roads, rail, power lines, pipelines). Parallel strips with plane racetrack turns or copter on-the-spot turns.
index.captureALineShorelineCliffFrontage: Capture a line (shoreline, cliff, frontage): the drawn line is the subject, the flight path is derived to the side, and the camera yaws onto the subject the whole way.
index.nPerimeterPassesFollowedByA: N perimeter passes followed by a grid fill of the interior.

survey_presets.n2dMapFastFlightSingleGrid: 2D map. Fast flight, single grid pass.
survey_presets.buildingsTerrainMeshesCrosshatchHighOver: Buildings, terrain meshes. Crosshatch + high overlap.
survey_presets.smallAreasLowAltitudeHighGsd: Small areas, low altitude, high GSD.
survey_presets.roadsRailPowerLinesFixedWing: Roads, rail, power lines. Fixed-wing strips with racetrack turns.
survey_presets.branchedCorridorsMultirotorTurnsOnThe: Branched corridors. Multirotor turns on the spot.
survey_presets.groundVehicleSetCorridorWidthDirectly: Ground vehicle. Set corridor width directly.

survey_vehicle.needsRoomToTurnOvershootAnd: Needs room to turn: overshoot and racetracks
survey_vehicle.surveysAsAFixedWingLift: Surveys as a fixed wing; lift motors for takeoff and landing
survey_vehicle.turnsOnTheSpotNoOvershoot: Turns on the spot: no overshoot
survey_vehicle.verticalForAVtolOtherwiseA: Vertical for a VTOL, otherwise a normal takeoff and RTL
survey_vehicle.vtolTakeoffVtolLandAtHome: VTOL takeoff, VTOL land at home
survey_vehicle.normalTakeoffAndReturnToLaunch: Normal takeoff and return to launch
survey_vehicle.missionOpensWithATakeoffTo: Mission opens with a takeoff to the survey altitude
survey_vehicle.launchManuallyThenSwitchToAuto: Launch manually, then switch to Auto. Also what a follow-on survey needs
survey_vehicle.returnToLaunchAfterTheLast: Return to launch after the last line
survey_vehicle.stopAtTheLastLineSo: Stop at the last line, so another survey or waypoint can follow
